title: bleekeria salubris

This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Bleekeria salubris for medicinal use.
